title: The Fire Circle—Raku Online Membership
source_quote:
Join The Fire Circle, Nate Winter Studios' online Raku community, and learn how to safely build, maintain, and fire your own Raku kiln with consistent results.
For just $29/month, less than $1 a day, get access to hours of video courses, live streams, community support, downloadable guides, material safety resources, and an ever-growing library of Raku education.
No commitment. Cancel anytime.
